_meta.beschreibung: Karten ohne internationalen Druck fuer TCG Showdown, inoffizielle englische Uebersetzung von limitlesstcg.com (cards/jp, translate=en). Erzeugt von scripts/showdown_jp_karten.py.

attacks.name: Storm Emeralda
attacks.effect: This attack does 50 damage for each Fire Energy and Lightning Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

ability.name: Roar of the Ruler
ability.effect: You may use this Ability when you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench. Look at the top 4 cards of your deck and attach up to 1 Basic Energy card you find there to this Pokémon. Shuffle the other cards and put them on the bottom of your deck.

attacks.name: Talon Hunt
attacks.effect: You may search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

ability.name: Exciting Dive
ability.effect: If this Pokémon is in your hand and you have any Colorless Mega Evolution Pokémon ex in play, you may use this Ability. Put this Pokémon onto your Bench.

karten.name: Adventuring Lantern
karten.effect: Search your deck for a Basic Fire Energy card and a Basic Lightning Energy card and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

karten.name: Legendary Lava Cave
karten.effect: You must play 2 different Legendary Lava Cave cards at once. Both cards act as a single Stadium while in play. Evolution Pokémon in play have no Abilities.
